headline: Dengue surge: Chittagong on high alert as cases rise
summary: Authorities are ramping up prevention efforts in Chittagong while DNCC Administratory seeks new medication to destroy dengue larvae.
details: Chittagong is currently on high alert as the city faces a surge in dengue fever cases, prompting authorities to intensify prevention and control measures.
In a parallel effort to combat the mosquito-borne illness, the Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) Administrator has announced plans to introduce new medication to destroy dengue larvae.
These measures come as health officials work to prevent a wider outbreak across major urban centers in Bangladesh.
The focus remains on eliminating breeding grounds and enhancing public awareness to reduce the transmission of the Aedes mosquito.
caption:
Chittagong is on high alert as dengue cases surge. New measures are being taken to combat the larvae.

Chittagong is currently on high alert as the city faces a surge in dengue fever cases, prompting authorities to intensify prevention and control measures.

In a parallel effort to combat the mosquito-borne illness, the Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) Administrator has announced plans to introduce new medication to destroy dengue larvae.

These measures come as health officials work to prevent a wider outbreak across major urban centers in Bangladesh.

The focus remains on eliminating breeding grounds and enhancing public awareness to reduce the transmission of the Aedes mosquito.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News

headline: Govt to reform cyber laws to make them more timely
summary: Information Minister says necessary legal reforms will be undertaken to modernize the digital regulations.
details: The Bangladesh government has announced plans to reform its cyber laws to ensure they are up-to-date and timely.
Information Minister Mohammad Sadeque Arefin has stated that necessary legal reforms will be carried out to make the laws more effective.
The move aims to modernize the digital legal framework to better reflect current technological advancements and societal needs.
The government intends to ensure that the laws are updated to remain relevant in the evolving digital landscape.
caption:
Bangladesh is updating its digital laws. The government has announced plans to reform cyber laws to make them them more timely.
